newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil barge steady in quiet discussion.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil barge steady in quiet discussion.

text.p: European gas oil differentials were stable on Thursday with the outright price under pressure and heating oil barges changing hands at steady values, traders said.
A barge of 0.2 percent sulphur heating oil for first half of July changed hands at a 50 cent premium to July IPE gas oil futures, a steady differential.

Traders gave differing assessments for prompt heating oil barges. Some valued the product at flat to 50 cents over July, saying buyers were hard to find. Others put heating oil for the first half of July at 25 cents to $1 over the IPE front month.
On the futures market July IPE was trading $1.25 cents adrift at $166.25 a tonne, under pressure from signs of lower demand despite supportive technicals.
Low sulphur diesel barges saw only intermittent inquiry. The product was offered at $5.50 over July IPE fob Rotterdam, $5.25 basis Flushing and $5.25/$5.50 into Amsterdam.

Cargoes got off to a slow start following low sulphur diesel trades into Amsterdam and Le Havre on Wednesday at cif differentials of between $5.50 and $6.50. German DIN heating oil was assessed at July IPE +$3.00/$3.50 cif NWE.
